snippet.title: Rhythm Adventure Game "Morpho Reverie" 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
Let music lead you to your kindred soul.
Welcome to the world of the artcore narrative rhythm game Morpho Reverie.
The demo is planned to launch in fall 2026—stay tuned for more information!

▼Add to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057180

------------------------------------------------

🦋Voice cast featured in the PV:
Rein (Male Version) - Aoi Ichikawa
Rein (Female Version) - Shion Wakayama
Keeva - Madoka Yonezawa 

🦋BGM by ARForest

------------------------------------------------

▼Official Homepage
http://www.morphoreverie.com/

▼Official X
